semantics.reset: Original: positive edge triggered asynchronous areset resets to walking_left; asserted reset also dominates positive clock edges.
semantics.clock: Original: all sequential logic triggered on positive clock edge.
semantics.transitions: From walking_left, bump_left causes walking_right; otherwise hold. From walking_right, bump_right causes walking_left; otherwise hold. Both bumps therefore reverse current direction.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: walking_left gives walk_left=1, walk_right=0; walking_right gives walk_left=0, walk_right=1.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; no initialization imposed before first reset.

numeric.port_widths: All ports one bit per original interface
numeric.state_encoding: One internal bit suffices for two states

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral direction model from original obstacle and both-bumps rules
verification.sampling: Check outputs after NBA settlement following clock/reset edges; check stable Moore outputs between clock edges
verification.coverage: Every input combination in each direction; simultaneous bumps; irrelevant-side bumps; repeated bumps; asynchronous reset away from clock; reset dominance and release
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up behavior before areset is unspecified; tests do not demand a known initial direction.

Single bumps are interpreted as obstacles relevant to the current walking direction; opposite-side bumps preserve direction. This follows the two-state direction/obstacle model and the explicit both-sides reversal rule.
